record.paper_title: Open problems in deformations of Artinian algebras, Hilbert schemes and around
record.original_question: For most triples (n, d, r), is the very compressed locus VC^r_{n,d} inside the Quot scheme either contained in the principal component or itself an irreducible component, with only a short finite exceptional list?

evidence.quote: Problem XVII. Is the following alternative true for most (n, d, r): VCr_n,d lies in the principal component or forms a component?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and fix positive integers $n$, $d$, and $r$. Consider the Quot scheme $\mathrm{Quot}_{n,d}^r := \mathrm{Quot}(\mathcal{O}^{\oplus r}_{\mathbb{A}^n}, d)$ parametrizing quotients $\mathcal{O}^{\oplus r}_{\mathbb{A}^n} \twoheadrightarrow Q$ where $Q$ is a coherent sheaf of length $d$ supported at the origin (equivalently, finite-length quotient modules of $k[[x_1,\dots,x_n]]^{\oplus r}$ of dimension $d$ over $k$). The principal component $\mathrm{Quot}_{n,d}^{r,\mathrm{prin}}$ is defined as the closure of the locus of quotients $Q$ corresponding to $r$-tuples of ideals (or, equivalently, the closure of the locus of quotients whose annihilator defines a reduced subscheme of $d$ distinct points, suitably interpreted) — i.e. the smoothable component.

For a finite-length quotient $M$ of $k[[x_1,\dots,x_n]]^{\oplus r}$ with Hilbert function $h_M(i) = \dim_k M_i$, set $h_M^{\max}(i) := \min\bigl(r \binom{n+i-1}{i},\, d - \sum_{j<i} h_M(j)\bigr)$, the maximum possible value of $h_M(i)$ given the previous values. The quotient $M$ is called very compressed if $h_M(i) = h_M^{\max}(i)$ for every $i \geq 0$. Let $\mathrm{VC}^r_{n,d} \subseteq \mathrm{Quot}_{n,d}^r$ denote the locally closed locus of very compressed quotients.

Question: Determine whether, for all triples $(n,d,r)$ outside a finite explicit exceptional set, the following alternative holds:
$$\mathrm{VC}^r_{n,d} \subseteq \mathrm{Quot}_{n,d}^{r,\mathrm{prin}} \quad \text{or} \quad \overline{\mathrm{VC}^r_{n,d}} \text{ is an irreducible component of } \mathrm{Quot}_{n,d}^r.$$
artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this dichotomy could be located. It is posed as an open problem in a list of open problems concerning deformations of Artinian algebras and Hilbert/Quot schemes, and the broader study of compressed-algebra components of Hilbert and Quot schemes remains an active research area with only partial results known.

status_evidence.title: Elementary components of Hilbert schemes of points (Jelisiejew)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of compressed algebras providing elementary components of Hilbert schemes of points.
status_evidence.claim: Compressed algebras are a known source of elementary components, but a full dichotomy for the very compressed locus inside Quot schemes is not established.

status_evidence.title: New elementary components of the Gorenstein locus of the Hilbert scheme of points
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work constructs new elementary components from compressed Gorenstein algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Research on whether compressed loci form components is ongoing, with new components still being found rather than a complete classification.
